text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I made it onto the board! Looks like my 
training is paying off!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I didn't reach 1st place, but... thanks to 
this, I know what I need to work on!
choice_data_list: Let's work on overcoming our weak points.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much. Fufu, I'm so glad!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Step by step, but steadily moving forward. 
Next time, I'll take 1st place, just you 
watch!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I need to take a hard look at my 
challenges to figure out how I can win.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, once we're back, I want to 
discuss how to tackle our weaknesses right 
away!
